facts.business: Tusaldah Limited is transitioning from textile and commodity trading to a wholesale trading and distribution platform focused on FMCG and beverage categories.
key_risks: Execution risk in establishing supplier relationships, customer networks, logistics processes and working-capital systems
Sensitivity to inventory cycles and customer credit in trading business
Commodity-price volatility and changes in procurement costs affecting gross margins
Product acceptance and competitive risks in new categories
Licensing, excise and compliance requirements for regulated beverage categories
Foreign-exchange fluctuations, freight costs, geopolitical developments, customs regulations, payment risks and country-specific business conditions in international trade
facts.related_party_note: Any transactions with related parties will continue to be governed by applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI Listing Regulations. The Company intends to maintain appropriate distinction between the listed Company and businesses or assets belonging to promoter/group entities.
